description: Use when: what is this Solana address and what does it hold? Look up any Solana address from public RPC data: account type (wallet, token mint, token account, program, program-owned), SOL balance, SPL and Token-2022 balances with names, wallet age from its first transaction (lower bound for very busy wallets), last active time, tx counts for 24h/7d/30d, recent transactions, and flags for fake copycat tokens (scam airdrops), frozen accounts and live token delegates. No USD prices. Costs $0.005.
name: solana_address_lookup
